title: A Geometric Principle for Path Selection in Directed Acyclic Graphs
summary: There are many types of path between nodes of a Directed acyclic graph (DAG), including the shortest and longest paths. Here, we ask whether the choice of path used in any analysis reflects the geometry of the latent space in which the DAG is embedded.
